description: The /api/transport route module: create apps/api/src/routes/transport.ts with all 34 routes mirroring hostel.ts (gated + per-permission + withTenant + same-tx audit + deny-returns-4xx), the advisory-lock concurrency-safe enrollment with capacity derived from the ACTIVE assignment's vehicle, the capacity-reduction and MAINTENANCE guards, fee-as-string metadata, reports + ExcelJS export, and the list-shaped 200-empty-on-no-profile self-service routes. Register it in server.ts. Depends on FEAT-001 (Prisma models) and FEAT-002 (permission keys, audit keys, Zod schemas).
steps: Create apps/api/src/routes/transport.ts exporting `async function transportRoutes(app: FastifyInstance)`. Import the transport Zod schemas from @campusgate/shared, withTenant + Prisma from @campusgate/db, authenticate, requirePermission + requireModuleActive, recordAuditEvent. Set MODULE_KEY='transport'. Add the top-level `app.addHook('preHandler', authenticate)` and copy the hostel shared helpers verbatim: actor, deny/isDeny, isUniqueViolation, isRestrictViolation, advisoryLock, countActiveEnrollments(tx,inst,routeId)=count ACTIVE enrollments for a route, resolveSelf(tx,inst,userId)=findFirst StudentProfile by userId+institutionId. Add enrollLockKey(inst,routeId)=`transportenroll:${inst}:${routeId}`.

Implement management routes 1-14 (design §C.1): POST/PATCH/GET vehicles, drivers, routes, stops. Each mutation audited in-tx; each read requires transport.view. PATCH /vehicles/:id implements the §B.5 capacity-reduction guard: when seatCapacity is reduced, for every route with an ACTIVE assignment to this vehicle, acquire advisoryLock(enrollLockKey(inst,routeId)) in sorted-routeId order, and if newCapacity < countActiveEnrollments(route) for ANY such route, record a DENIED transport.vehicle.updated audit and return 409 'capacity below active enrollment' (metadata: offending routeId + counts). feeAmount is accepted as a digits-string (Zod) and serialized back as a string in every response that returns a route.

Implement routes 15-17 assignments: POST /routes/:id/assignments loads the target vehicle (tenant-filtered); if vehicle.status==='MAINTENANCE' record DENIED transport.assignment.created and return 409 'vehicle in maintenance' (§B.7); insert the ACTIVE assignment and map P2002 -> 409 'route already assigned' locally (the one-ACTIVE-per-route partial unique). POST /assignments/:id/end sets status ENDED + effectiveTo; GET /routes/:id/assignments lists.

Implement routes 18-21 enrollments using the §B.3 idiom in one withTenant tx: (1) advisoryLock(enrollLockKey(inst,routeId)); (2) load route (404 if absent), load its ACTIVE assignment — if none, DENIED transport.enrollment.created + 409 'route has no active vehicle assignment'; (3) read seatCapacity from the assignment's vehicle (same-tenant); (4) validate stopId belongs to the route (404 'stop not found on route'); (5) one-active-per-(student,route) count>=1 -> DENIED + 409 'student already enrolled on route'; (6) countActiveEnrollments+1 > seatCapacity -> DENIED + 409 'route full'; (7) insert, catching P2002 -> DENIED + 409 'student already enrolled on route'; SUCCESS audit in-tx. POST /enrollments/:id/suspend (ACTIVE->SUSPENDED, in-handler legality + guard backstop, DENIED reuses transport.enrollment.suspended), POST /enrollments/:id/end (ACTIVE/SUSPENDED->ENDED, sets endedAt, DENIED reuses transport.enrollment.ended), GET /enrollments (filter routeId/status). Deny messages for non-transition denials MUST NOT contain the word 'illegal'.

Implement routes 22-24 schedules (POST /routes/:id/schedules, PATCH /schedules/:id, GET /routes/:id/schedules) and 25-27 maintenance (POST /maintenance creates OPEN with reportedByUserId=caller; POST /maintenance/:id/transition does in-handler legality check then relies on the DB guard; illegal transition -> DENIED transport.maintenance.transitioned + 409 'illegal status transition'; GET /maintenance filter vehicleId/status).

Implement reports 28-30: GET /reports/roster (enrolled students per route, query routeId), GET /reports/utilization (per route effective capacity vs active enrollment; capacity null + utilization null when no ACTIVE assignment per §B.6), GET /reports/roster/export (ExcelJS XLSX, audited transport.roster.exported — mirror the hostel export).

Implement self-service routes 31-34 (all transport.view_own + requireModuleActive('transport')): GET /me/enrollments, /me/routes, /me/schedules, /me/fees. Each resolves resolveSelf; LIST-shaped payloads { enrollments|routes|schedules|fees: [...] }. Return 200 with an EMPTY list both when there is no StudentProfile AND when the profile has no ACTIVE enrollment — NEVER 404, NEVER a null scalar. DO NOT copy hostel's 404 noProfile branch. Return every ACTIVE enrollment (a student may be on >1 route). Ordering: /me/enrollments and /me/routes and /me/fees by enrolledAt ASC, id ASC; /me/schedules by owning-route enrollment order then (date NULLS LAST, dayOfWeek, departureTime, id). feeAmount serialized as a string. Reads write no audit.

In apps/api/src/server.ts add `import { transportRoutes } from "./routes/transport.js";` (beside the hostel import ~line 17) and `await app.register(transportRoutes, { prefix: "/api/transport" });` (beside the hostel registration ~line 63).
Run build + fast suite; commit locally on main (do not push).
acceptance_criteria: `npm run build -w @campusgate/api` compiles with no type errors (all 34 handlers typed; the Prisma transport delegates and the Zod schemas resolve).
The full fast suite `npm test -w @campusgate/api` shows no regression in the existing 596 tests.

transport.ts carries no non-transition deny message containing the word 'illegal'; the only 'illegal' messages are the genuine transition denials ('illegal status transition'), consistent with the isRestrictViolation substring match.
transportRoutes is registered at /api/transport in server.ts.
findings:
DONE. Created apps/api/src/routes/transport.ts (34 routes) and registered transportRoutes at /api/transport in server.ts (import beside hostel at top, register beside hostel). Build is clean; fast suite shows no transport-related regression.

ROUTE MAP (34, in order):
- Management 1-14: 1 POST /vehicles, 2 PATCH /vehicles/:id (with the §B.5 capacity-reduction guard), 3 GET /vehicles, 4 GET /vehicles/:id, 5 POST /drivers, 6 PATCH /drivers/:id, 7 GET /drivers, 8 POST /routes, 9 PATCH /routes/:id, 10 GET /routes, 11 GET /routes/:id, 12 POST /routes/:id/stops, 13 PATCH /stops/:id, 14 GET /routes/:id/stops.
- Assignments 15-17: 15 POST /routes/:id/assignments (MAINTENANCE guard §B.7 + P2002->409 'route already assigned'), 16 POST /assignments/:id/end, 17 GET /routes/:id/assignments.
- Enrollments 18-21: 18 POST /enrollments (§B.3 route-lock idiom: advisoryLock(enrollLockKey) -> load route -> load ACTIVE assignment (else DENIED 'route has no active vehicle assignment') -> seatCapacity from assignment's vehicle -> validate stop-on-route -> one-active-per-(student,route) -> capacity 'route full' -> insert w/ P2002 backstop -> SUCCESS), 19 POST /enrollments/:id/suspend, 20 POST /enrollments/:id/end, 21 GET /enrollments (routeId/status filter).
- Schedules 22-24, Maintenance 25-27: 22 POST /routes/:id/schedules, 23 PATCH /schedules/:id, 24 GET /routes/:id/schedules, 25 POST /maintenance (OPEN, reportedByUserId=caller), 26 POST /maintenance/:id/transition (in-handler legality + DB-guard backstop, 'illegal status transition'), 27 GET /maintenance (vehicleId/status filter).
- Reports 28-30: 28 GET /reports/roster (ACTIVE enrollments, optional routeId), 29 GET /reports/utilization (effective capacity from ACTIVE assignment's vehicle; capacity AND utilization null when no ACTIVE assignment per §B.6), 30 GET /reports/roster/export (ExcelJS XLSX, audited transport.roster.exported).
- Self-service 31-34 (transport.view_own): 31 GET /me/enrollments, 32 GET /me/routes, 33 GET /me/schedules, 34 GET /me/fees. ALL LIST-shaped { enrollments|routes|schedules|fees: [...] }; return 200 + EMPTY list on no-StudentProfile AND on no-ACTIVE-enrollment (NO 404 noProfile branch, NO null scalar). Returns every ACTIVE enrollment (student may be on >1 route). Ordering: enrollments/routes/fees by enrolledAt ASC, id ASC; schedules by owning-route enrollment order then (date NULLS LAST, dayOfWeek, departureTime, id). Reads write no audit.

KEY DECISIONS / NOTES FOR LATER STEPS (tests):
- feeAmount is int paise in the DB; serialized as a decimal-digit STRING (or null) on every response returning a route, via a local serializeRoute() helper, and in GET /me/fees. On input it is accepted as a digits-string by the Zod schema and converted with Number(...) before the DB write.
- 'illegal'-word discipline (acceptance #3 / isRestrictViolation): the ONLY deny messages containing 'illegal' are the genuine transition denials 'illegal status transition' (maintenance transition #26; and the isRestrictViolation->409 backstop in assignment/end, enrollment/suspend, enrollment/end). All non-transition denials avoid the word: 'enrollment not active' (suspend), 'enrollment already ended' (end), 'assignment not active' (assignment/end), 'route full', 'student already enrolled on route', 'route has no active vehicle assignment', 'vehicle in maintenance', 'route already assigned', 'capacity below active enrollment'. Verified by grep: the only 'illegal' occurrences in transport.ts are the transition strings.
- Zod schema names used (per FEAT-002's naming note, to avoid hostel collisions): createTransportMaintenanceSchema + transportMaintenanceTransitionSchema; all others collision-free (createVehicle/patchVehicle, createDriver/patchDriver, createRoute/patchRoute, createStop/patchStop, createAssignment, createEnrollment, createSchedule/patchSchedule, transportListQuerySchema).
- Shared helpers copied verbatim from hostel.ts: actor, deny/isDeny, isUniqueViolation, isRestrictViolation, advisoryLock, resolveSelf; plus transport-specific enrollLockKey(inst,routeId)=`transportenroll:${inst}:${routeId}` and countActiveEnrollments(tx,inst,routeId).
- Business-unique P2002 mapping (local, per route): vehicles 'registration number already exists'; drivers 'license number already exists'; routes 'route code already exists'; stops 'stop sequence already exists on route'.
- Schedule stop-on-route validation: POST and PATCH both confirm a named stopId belongs to the schedule's route (composite-FK backstop) and 404 'stop not found on route' otherwise.

VERIFICATION:
- `npm run build -w @campusgate/api` — exit 0, no type errors (all 34 handlers typed; Prisma transport delegates + Zod types resolve). Prisma client regenerated by the build's prisma generate.
- `npm test -w @campusgate/api` — 595/596 passing. The ONLY failure is a PRE-EXISTING, transport-UNRELATED flaky timeout in src/services/__tests__/mfa.test.ts ('consumes a recovery code once (single-use)'), a bcrypt cost-12 test with a 30_000ms timeout that intermittently exceeds the limit under CPU contention (its sibling 'rejects a code...' took 27.7s in the same run; in isolation 2 of the 3 recovery-code tests time out). transport.ts imports/alters nothing in the MFA path, so this is not a regression from FEAT-003. All transport.ts type-checking is covered by the clean build; behavioral live-DB tests are a later FEAT's scope.
- transportRoutes registered at /api/transport in server.ts (acceptance #4).
